documented_platform_capabilities.scope: Native Node.js request/response objects and a createServer-based blank Advanced I/O function are documented.
Single-row insert and ROWID-based update SDK calls are documented.
The IsUnique column constraint is documented without the nullable or duplicate-error behavior required below.
Function-job submission and bounded platform retry configuration are documented.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: No authoritative multi-row transaction or compare-and-set contract proves one atomic transition across admission identity, one of 25 slots, admitted count, handled count, canonical call binding, and stop state.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Prove a concrete Catalyst Development algorithm under concurrent 25th/26th admission and duplicate post-call finalization, including crash recovery and exact readback.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: Published IsUnique documentation does not establish nullable uniqueness semantics for pre-provisioned slots or the exact SDK duplicate-conflict code and shape.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Provision the proposed Development schema, run concurrent insert/claim probes, and independently read back uniqueness and duplicate-error behavior without publishing private identifiers.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: The exact affected-row response for conditional ZCQL UPDATE and the result of a timeout after possible commit are not established for the pinned runtime.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Verify zero-row/one-row response shapes, atomic predicate evaluation, timeout ambiguity, and authoritative readback in Catalyst Development.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: No deployed store contract proves that a stale event worker cannot mutate a call, claim notification delivery, or publish Analytics after lease takeover.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Implement and concurrency-test conditional lease-token checks on every durable mutation and side-effect claim against the real Data Store adapter.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: The exact pinned SDK surface, job payload/response shape, target invocation shape, delivery/retry semantics, Development binding, and receipt-to-job crash window are not verified.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Pin the supported SDK, configure a private Development Function Job Pool and worker, test duplicate/delayed/lost job behavior, and add a durable scanner so receipt persistence and job submission cannot silently split.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: Repository conventions for the platform environment header, SDK environment value, unchanged raw request bytes, and Advanced I/O response behavior have not been served or deployed for this function.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Run Catalyst CLI serve and a Development deployment using synthetic signed bytes; prove Development identity from platform-derived state and reject Production before Data Store or provider access.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: No notification provider or approved Development destination contract defines idempotency-key enforcement, outcome readback, timeout ambiguity, rate limits, or terminal response mapping.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Select one approved provider and Development-only destination, document its official contract, implement one bounded adapter, and verify send/readback without real prospect or customer delivery.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: No approved Development Analytics import/upsert boundary defines the target schema, idempotency key, response validation, or authoritative readback.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Approve one minimized Development-only Analytics handoff and verify idempotent upsert/readback using synthetic call facts.

blocking_evidence_gaps.missing_contract: Retell pre-call requests have no call_id and retry stability of event_timestamp is unproven, so an elapsed-time release cannot distinguish an abandoned request from a delayed handled call.
blocking_evidence_gaps.required_closure: Obtain provider-authoritative Development evidence that deterministically releases or finalizes an orphan while preserving the 25 eligible-handled-call ceiling.
